tools.name: search_use_cases
tools.description: Search the scikit-learn Central use case library. Returns ranked matches with metadata. Use this when the user describes a machine learning problem, application field, problem type, or data type they want to implement in Python.

query.description: Free-text description of the ML problem (e.g. 'fraud detection for banking', 'predict customer churn')

application_field.description: Filter by application field. Valid values: e-commerce, insurance, real-estate

problem_type.description: Filter by problem type. Valid values: classification, regression

data_type.description: Filter by data type. Valid values: tabular, text

tools.name: get_use_case
tools.description: Get full details and the complete runnable Python source code for a specific use case. Call this after search_use_cases to retrieve the code example.

id.description: UUID or slug of the use case (from search_use_cases results)

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List packages in the scikit-learn ecosystem catalog with descriptions and tags. Use when the user asks what libraries are available for a task, or what a specific package (e.g. skrub, skore) does.

query.description: Free-text filter against package name and description

tools.name: list_taxonomy
tools.description: Returns all valid taxonomy values: application fields, problem types, data types, and package IDs. Call this first to discover what filter values are available before calling search_use_cases.
